score.note: Facebook does not publish ad spend in Algeria: no spend is shown or estimated. The score ranks ads with what the library shows; an ad that lasts is not always profitable, compare with your Pilotix figures.

src.title: Where this data comes from
src.fb: Active ads read in Facebook’s public library (country: Algeria) for your keywords in Arabic, Darija and French. Copies of the same ad are grouped.
src.noSpend: Facebook does not publish Algerian ad spend: the score uses days online, copies, video, placements and other sellers. Off-topic ads are removed by the AI or by you (“Not relevant”).

via.extension: Your Chrome opens Facebook’s library and reads the ads when you click “Search”. Free, no automatic scan.
via.scrapecreators: The Pilotix server searches with your ScrapeCreators key, on demand and every morning. It also reads competitors’ sites (price, platform, form).
via.searchapi: The Pilotix server searches with your SearchAPI.io key, on demand and every morning. It also reads competitors’ sites (price, platform, form).

src.aiOn: Claude (the Message AI agent’s key) reads every ad and prepares the brief.
src.aiOnPilot: Claude (Pilotix’s AI) reads every ad and prepares the brief.
src.aiOff: AI is not on: no reading of the ads, no hooks.
src.aiOffPilot: Pilotix’s AI is not on yet: no reading of the ads, no hooks.

set.title: AI Spy settings
set.help: Where the ads come from, the morning scan, your own pages and the AI.
set.adminOnly: Only an administrator can change these settings.
set.sourceHelp: Facebook refuses its ad pages to servers: either your Chrome reads them (free), or a paid service does it for the server.

extension.name: Pilotix Chrome extension
extension.desc: On-demand search from your computer: your Chrome opens Facebook’s Ad Library and reads the ads, one keyword at a time. No automatic scan.

scrapecreators.name: ScrapeCreators
scrapecreators.desc: Paid key used by the Pilotix server: automatic scan every morning, no computer needed. Credits bought once.

searchapi.name: SearchAPI.io
searchapi.desc: Paid key used by the Pilotix server: automatic scan every morning, Algeria officially supported.

set.missingKey: Add the {{name}} key: without it, no search can run.
set.keyStored: A key is saved (never shown). Type a new one to replace it.
set.removeAsk: Remove this key? Searching with this source will stop.
set.testOk: Valid key: {{n}} active ads found in Algeria for “poussette”.
set.testNone: No ad found: check the key and your credit balance.
set.daily: Scan the followed products every morning
set.dailyHelp: Paid sources: the server searches the included products’ keywords once a day and tells you what changed.
set.scanExt: With the Chrome extension, searching happens on demand from your computer: no automatic scan.
set.ownHint: One line per Facebook page or site: your ads are marked “You” and counted apart.
set.aiHelp: The AI analysis (relevance, hook, angle, offer, brief) uses the Message AI agent’s (Dellal) Claude key. Without it, AI Spy shows the figures and a simple summary.

ext.help: Free. It opens Facebook’s Ad Library in a tab of your Chrome, reads the ads and sends them to Pilotix. Nothing is installed on the server.
